2607.11523.title: Vinci2: Providing Proactive Assistance in Continuous Egocentric Videos
2607.11523.paper_summary: When should an intelligent assistant speak up without being asked? Continuous egocentric video offers rich, evolving context that enables a new form of assistance: one that is proactive rather than merely reactive. Yet existing approaches either wait passively for user queries or treat every detected event as requiring a response, without considering the user's history, current activity, or whether assistance would actually be welcome. We reframe proactive assistance as a context-dependent decision problem: the agent must not only perceive what is happening, but reason over accumulated temporal context to determine when and whether to intervene. To this end, we present Vinci2, a proactive egocentric assistance system that advances the on-device assistant Vinci from reactive response toward proactivity. On the evaluation side, we present EgoServe, the first large-scale benchmark for proactive assistance in continuous egocentric video. EgoServe comprises over 3,000 service instances organized along 4 temporal memory horizons, ranging from immediate safety alerts to long-term habit coaching, across 10 service categories. On the modeling side, we propose EgoMemo, a training-free, memory-augmented agent that maintains three complementary memory representations: multi-scale temporal summaries, a semantic knowledge graph, and visual embedding archives. At each timestep, EgoMemo performs retrieval-augmented reasoning to determine whether assistance is warranted and, if so, produces contextually grounded responses. Experiments demonstrate that EgoMemo establishes strong baselines on EgoServe while remaining competitive on existing egocentric benchmarks. Our benchmark and code are publicly available at \href{https://sitonggong.github.io/EgoServe-page/}{Vinci2}.
2607.11523.paper_summary_zh: 當智能助手應該在未被要求的情況下主動發言？持續的自我中心視頻提供了豐富且不斷演變的背景，使一種新的協助形式成為可能：這種形式是主動的，而不僅僅是被動反應。然而，現有的方法要麼被動等待用戶查詢，要麼將每個檢測到的事件視為需要回應的情況，而不考慮用戶的歷史、當前活動或是否實際上會歡迎協助。我們將主動協助重新框架為一個依賴於上下文的決策問題：代理不僅必須感知正在發生的事情，還必須在累積的時間上下文中進行推理，以確定何時以及是否介入。為此，我們提出了Vinci2，一個主動的自我中心協助系統，將反應式助手Vinci推進到主動性。 在評估方面，我們提出了EgoServe，這是第一個針對持續自我中心視頻的主動協助的大型基準。EgoServe包含超過3,000個服務實例，按照4個時間記憶範疇組織，範圍從即時安全警報到長期習慣指導，涵蓋10個服務類別。在建模方面，我們提出了EgoMemo，一個無需訓練的增強記憶代理，維持三種互補的記憶表示：多尺度時間摘要、語義知識圖和視覺嵌入檔案。在每個時間步，EgoMemo執行檢索增強推理，以確定是否需要協助，如果需要，則產生上下文相關的回應。實驗表明，EgoMemo在EgoServe上建立了強大的基準，同時在現有的自我中心基準上保持競爭力。我們的基準和代碼在\href{https://sitonggong.github.io/EgoServe-page/}{Vinci2}上公開可用。
